 Job description 
At AME, we develop and manufacture innovative, high-quality products by combining electronics, mechanics, software, and advanced manufacturing technologies. 
As a CNC Machinist, you are responsible for producing high-precision components and tooling within our mechanical manufacturing environment. You work with a modern CNC machine park and ensure that parts are machined accurately according to technical drawings, specifications, and required tolerances. 
What you'll do - 
Operate and set up CNC machines, including 5-axis simultaneous milling, Electrical Discharge Machining (EDM), Wire EDM, and precision grinding. - 
Read and interpret technical drawings, including dimensions, shapes, and tolerances. - 
Prepare machines, tools, and programs for production. - 
Check machined parts to ensure they meet the required specifications and quality standards. - 
Identify when adjustments or additions to CNC programs are required and discuss these with the CAM programmer. - 
Perform daily maintenance on machines and tools to ensure a safe and reliable working environment. - 
Contribute to continuous improvement of machining processes and ways of working. Job requirements 
Who are you? - 
MBO-level vocational education or equivalent working experience. - 
Experience with CNC machining and machining operations, preferably milling, grinding, and/or drilling. - 
Able to read and interpret technical drawings. - 
Accurate and quality-focused, with an eye for detail and precision. - 
Practical and hands-on, with a willingness to work with different machining technologies. - 
Able to work independently while collaborating effectively with colleagues. - 
Good command of English, both spoken and written. 
Why joining AME? - 
Work with modern CNC machinery and high-precision manufacturing technologies. -

The largest data centers in the Netherlands are in the Eemshaven. You keep the power they rely on running.
Right to work: You must already be allowed to work in the Netherlands. We do not sponsor visas or work permits.
As an Electrical Engineer Data Center you work on the critical electrical installations in the Eemshaven: UPS systems, standby generators, distribution boards and the measurement and control equipment that goes with them. You carry out preventive maintenance, inspect installations, take measurements, resolve faults and record every action, because in these buildings the documentation weighs as much as the work. You are there when the manufacturer commissions new systems, so you see up close how a site is built up. If you come from commercial and industrial buildings and UPS is new to you, you learn those systems here on the installation itself. The work asks for precision and reliability: in these buildings the power must never fail.
The essentials: Salary €3.300 to €4.100 per month · 38 hours per week · Fulltime · Based in Groningen.
In this role you earn €3.300 at entry, rising to €4.100 as an experienced engineer. Growing on to Senior can later reach €4.900, but you are applying now for the Data Center Engineer role.
What you bring
- MBO 3 or 4 Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience
- Solid experience as an electrical engineer in commercial and industrial buildings, for example offices, healthcare, industry or data centers
- Knowledge of UPS systems, distribution boards, backup power and instrumentation, extensive experience with them is a strong plus
- NEN 3140 VP and VCA, or the willingness to obtain them
- Driver's license B; Dutch and English at working level

What we offer
- Work in the largest and most secure data centers in the Netherlands
- Training and certification on UPS systems from Eaton and Schneider Electric
- NEN 3140, VCA, LOTO and ESD training
- The opportunity to obtain NEN 3840 (high voltage)
